protocol_metadata.about: f(x) Protocol is a DeFi system on Ethereum that splits yield-bearing assets (wstETH, WBTC) into a fully-collateralized stablecoin (fxUSD) and a fixed-leverage trading position (xPOSITION/sPOSITION) offering up to 7x long or 6x short exposure. Users can mint fxUSD against stETH or WBTC for a flat one-time fee, deposit into a stability pool to earn stETH staking rewards plus trading fees, or open leveraged ETH/BTC perpetual positions with a 'Liquidation Brake' rebalancing mechanism that avoids hard liquidations. The protocol is governed by FXN token holders via veFXN vote-escrow and managed by an AladdinDAO community multisig; it has shipped three generations (v1 variable-leverage, v2.0 fixed-leverage, v2.1 with short positions).
